mapper.select: select bi.id, bi.book_name as bookName, bi.cover_url as coverUrl, ai.author_name as authorName, bi.category_id as categoryId, bi.update_status as updateStatus, bi.book_intro as bookIntro, bi.word_count as wordCount, bi.latest_chapter_id as latestChapterId, bi.latest_chapter_name as latestChapterName from book_info as bi left join author_info ai on bi.author_id = ai.id where bi.category_id = #{categoryId} and bi.publish_status = 1

select bi.id, bi.book_name as bookName, bi.cover_url as coverUrl, ai.author_name as authorName, bi.category_id as categoryId, bi.update_status as updateStatus, bi.book_intro as bookIntro, bi.word_count as wordCount, bi.latest_chapter_id as latestChapterId, bi.latest_chapter_name as latestChapterName from book_info as bi left join author_info ai on bi.author_id = ai.id where bi.publish_status = 1 order by bi.update_time desc

select bi.id, bi.book_name as bookName, bi.cover_url as coverUrl, ai.author_name as authorName, bc.category_name as categoryName, bi.update_status as updateStatus, bi.book_intro as bookIntro, bi.chapter_count as chapterCount, bi.word_count as wordCount, bi.latest_chapter_id as latestChapterId, bi.latest_chapter_name as latestChapterName, bi.last_chapter_time as lastChapterTime from book_info as bi left join author_info as ai on bi.author_id = ai.id left join book_category as bc on bi.category_id = bc.id where bi.id = #{bookId} and bi.publish_status = 1

select bi.id, bi.book_name as bookName, bi.cover_url as coverUrl, ai.author_name as authorName, bi.book_intro as bookIntro, bc.category_name as categoryName from book_info bi left join author_info ai on bi.author_id = ai.id left join book_category bc on bi.category_id = bc.id where bi.publish_status = 1 order by bi.create_time desc limit #{limit}

select bi.id, bi.book_name as bookName, bi.cover_url as coverUrl, bi.update_status as updateStatus, bi.word_count as wordCount, bi.latest_chapter_name as latestChapterName, bi.last_chapter_time as lastChapterTime from book_info bi where bi.author_id = #{authorId} order by bi.update_time desc

select bi.id, bi.book_name as bookName, bi.cover_url as coverUrl, bc.category_name as categoryName, bi.publish_status as publishStatus, bi.update_status as updateStatus, bi.book_intro as bookIntro from book_info bi inner join book_category bc on bi.category_id = bc.id where bi.id = #{bookId} and bi.author_id = #{authorId}

select bi.id, bi.book_name as bookName, ai.author_name as authorName, bi.category_id as categoryId from book_info bi inner join author_info ai on bi.author_id = ai.id
bi.publish_status = 1
and (
bi.book_name like concat('%', #{bookName}, '%')
or
ai.author_name like concat('%', #{authorName}, '%')
)
order by bi.update_time desc limit 20
